tldr: Chiron transiting the 3rd house: a long healing chapter around voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication.
body: Chiron moving through the 3rd house can reopen old material around voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in voice, learning, and the everyday mind; school, siblings, or early speech may be the sore spot.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication. You become a communicator who reaches people others give up on.
shadow: Talking around the wound, or quietly doubting your own intelligence.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
